notes: The radios, sorted out: a WiFi join (clock sync at boot, update check, art, FILES, the WiFi test, the hotspot) used to tear the table link down underneath itself -- it now borrows the radio and hands it back
HOST / JOIN start the radio from scratch, check every step, and the lobby shows the radio line: channel, frames in and out, or why it did not start (tap to retry)
Bluetooth: a stack left half-down by a failed shutdown is reset before starting; low RAM moves the screen band aside; 'bluetooth would not start' now says how much memory was free
After a hosted game, RECORD ROUND and NEW GAME take every device back to the table lobby with the seats kept
Music: names up to 95 characters, skipped files are counted and said, and 'unplug the USB cable' when the PC still holds the drive
